Consider the following schema of a database designed for a university: Students (studentId: int, name: varchar(40), email: varchar(30), dob: date, specialization: int, GPA: real) Courses (courseId: int, name: varchar(40), credits: int) Offer (specialization: int, courseId: int, acYear: int, semester: int) Grades (studentId: int, courseId: int, acYear: int, calYear: int, semester: int, status: varchar(10), CAMarks: int, finalMark: int, grade: char(1)) GradePoints (grade: char(1), gradePoint: real) Enrollment (studentId: int, courseId: int, calYear: int, semester: int, basis: varchar(30))
